verification_notes: AUM (>$700M), fund count (7) and investment count (196) are from CB Insights' aggregated profile rather than the firm's own disclosure; the official site was not fetched directly. Stonebridge straddles early and late stage, included here for its seed-to-late-stage / growth coverage.
